description: This file appears to be a PHP source script for the TestLink open-source testing platform. It handles incoming requests, validates API keys, extracts test case information, checks user permissions, and redirects to a test case print page.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the TestLink system, providing methods to retrieve user data by API key and check user rights.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Represents a test case, providing methods to retrieve internal ID and all version IDs.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main function that processes incoming request parameters, validates API keys, extracts test case info, checks user permissions, and redirects accordingly.
